beats.say: Why is a marathon 26.2 miles? Blame the royal family.
It sounds like a random number. It isn't.
At the 1908 London Olympics, the race started at Windsor Castle and finished in front of the royal box. That made it 26 miles and 385 yards.
The leader, Dorando Pietri, collapsed several times in the stadium. Officials helped him over the line, so he was disqualified, and American Johnny Hayes won.
Queen Alexandra gave Pietri a trophy anyway.
And that royal route is why the marathon is still 26.2 miles.

It started at Windsor Castle and finished in front of the royal box
Dorando Pietri collapsed several times, was helped by officials and disqualified
Johnny Hayes of the USA was the winner
Queen Alexandra gave Pietri a trophy
The 1908 distance became the standard marathon distance
